system: bcc lithium, one atom per primitive cell; primitive vectors (a/2)(-1,1,1), (a/2)(1,-1,1), (a/2)(1,1,-1) before strain; PBE; SSSP 1.3 precision ultrasoft pseudopotential li_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF (GBRV 1.4, 1s2 2s1 in valence); Marzari-Vanderbilt cold smearing; Gamma-centred Monkhorst-Pack meshes; ecutrho = 8 x ecutwfc; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x on 2 cores

request.lattice_A: cubic lattice parameter a in Angstrom
request.strain_voigt: optional, default [0,0,0,0,0,0]: [e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6] = [eps_xx, eps_yy, eps_zz, 2 eps_yz, 2 eps_xz, 2 eps_xy] (engineering shears); every lattice vector r becomes (1 + eps) r
request.kmesh: n of an n x n x n Gamma-centred Monkhorst-Pack mesh of the (strained) primitive cell

cost_notes: Units per request (about one unit per minute of computing). The class is the point symmetry of the strained lattice (number of operations: cubic 48, tetragonal 16, trigonal 12, orthorhombic 8, monoclinic 4, triclinic 2) and sets the number of irreducible k-points; the allowed meshes per class are the keys. ecutwfc_Ry 60 doubles the cost and is available when the 40 Ry cost is at most 4. Failed jobs stay charged.

result_units.energies: Ry and eV per cell (one atom); free_energy = F = E - TS (the variational functional, consistent with the stress); internal_energy = E
result_units.stress_GPa: 3x3 Cauchy stress of the strained cell in GPa, Quantum ESPRESSO sign convention (positive = compressive); pressure_GPa = trace/3
